# Greene Studios

> Digital design studio. Brand identity, websites and web/mobile products, designed and built in-house. Remote, working worldwide.

## Pages
- [Home](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/): globe hero, selected work, services
- [Work](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/work): live client sites and nine studio concept brands
- [Services](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/services): what the studio does
- [Pricing](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/pricing): Brand Identity, Website, Product Build, Monthly Retainer
- [Start here](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/start): six-question quiz that recommends a starting package
- [Contact](https://greene-studios.vercel.app/contact): project brief

## Notes
- Concept brands (Luminary, Vera, Arc, Bloom, Onyx, Prism, Pace, Chopbox, Kora) are self-initiated studio work, not client projects. Each has a working demo site under /demo/<name>.
- Contact: hello@greenestudios.com
